ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: From the constraint conditions x≥0, y≥0, x+2y≤4, it can be known that the feasible region is a triangular region in the first quadrant, with vertices (0,0), (4,0), and (0,2). Rewrite z=\frac{y+2}{x-1} as z=\frac{y-(-2)}{x-1}; it represents the slope of the line connecting the fixed point P=(1,-2) and the feasible point (x,y). Since when x=1 the denominator is 0, z is undefined, so discuss the two parts x<1 and x>1 separately. When x<1, the denominator x-1<0, while y+2>0, so z<0. Geometrically, it is the slope from point P to feasible points in the left part of the triangle. The maximum value of the negative slope occurs at (0,0), at which time z=\frac{0+2}{0-1}=-2; when the feasible point approaches the line x=1 from the left, the denominator tends to 0^-, and the numerator is still positive, therefore z tends to -∞. So the value range of this part is (-∞,-2]. When x>1, the denominator x-1>0, and y+2>0, so z>0. Geometrically, it is the slope from point P to feasible points in the right part of the triangle. The minimum value of the positive slope occurs at the right-end vertex (4,0), at which time z=\frac{0+2}{4-1}=\frac{2}{3}; when the feasible point approaches the line x=1 from the right, the denominator tends to 0^+, and the numerator is still positive, therefore z tends to +∞. So the value range of this part is [\frac{2}{3},+∞). Combining the two parts, the value range of z is (-∞,-2]∪[\frac{2}{3},+∞).

raw_record.question_text: If the real numbers $x 、 y$ satisfy $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x+2 y-4 \leq 0, \\ x \geq 0, \\ y \geq 0,\end{array}\right.$, then the range of values of $z=\frac{y+2}{x-1}$ is ( )

method.method_draft: Geometric slope method. Read the constraints as the triangular feasible region x>=0, y>=0, x+2y<=4 with vertices (0,0), (4,0), (0,2). Rewrite z=(y+2)/(x-1) as the slope of the line joining the fixed point P=(1,-2) to a feasible point (x,y), since z=(y-(-2))/(x-1). Split feasible points by x<1 and x>1 because x=1 makes z undefined. For x<1, slopes from P to the left part of the triangle are negative; the largest negative slope occurs at (0,0), giving z=-2, and as feasible points approach the line x=1 from the left, the denominator tends to 0- while y+2>0, so z tends to -infinity. This gives (-infinity,-2]. For x>1, slopes are positive; the smallest positive slope occurs along the ray from P touching the rightmost vertex (4,0), giving z=2/3, and as points approach x=1 from the right, z tends to +infinity. This gives [2/3,+infinity). Combine the two intervals.
method.CoT_raw:
由约束条件 x≥0，y≥0，x+2y≤4 可知，可行域是第一象限内的三角形区域，顶点为 (0,0)、(4,0)、(0,2)。将 z=\frac{y+2}{x-1} 改写为 z=\frac{y-(-2)}{x-1}，它表示固定点 P=(1,-2) 与可行点 (x,y) 连线的斜率。由于 x=1 时分母为 0，z 无定义，所以分 x<1 与 x>1 两部分讨论。

当 x<1 时，分母 x-1<0，而 y+2>0，所以 z<0。几何上是点 P 到三角形左侧部分可行点的斜率。负斜率的最大值出现在 (0,0)，此时 z=\frac{0+2}{0-1}=-2；当可行点从左侧趋近于直线 x=1 时，分母趋于 0^-，分子仍为正，因此 z 趋于 -∞。所以这一部分取值为 (-∞,-2]。

当 x>1 时，分母 x-1>0，且 y+2>0，所以 z>0。几何上是点 P 到三角形右侧部分可行点的斜率。正斜率的最小值出现在右端顶点 (4,0)，此时 z=\frac{0+2}{4-1}=\frac{2}{3}；当可行点从右侧趋近于直线 x=1 时，分母趋于 0^+，分子仍为正，因此 z 趋于 +∞。所以这一部分取值为 [\frac{2}{3},+∞)。

综合两部分，z 的取值范围为 (-∞,-2]∪[\frac{2}{3},+∞)。

method.method_draft: Parameter-existence algebra method. Treat z as a parameter and ask for which z there exists a feasible (x,y). From z=(y+2)/(x-1), get y=z(x-1)-2. Substitute into the constraints y>=0 and x+2y<=4: z(x-1)>=2 and (1+2z)x<=8+2z, with x>=0. Since y+2>0, z has the same sign as 1/(x-1), so handle z>0 and z<0 separately; z=0 is impossible. For z>0, the first inequality gives x>=1+2/z, and the second gives x<=(8+2z)/(1+2z). Existence requires 1+2/z <= (8+2z)/(1+2z), which simplifies to z>=2/3. For z<0, the first inequality gives x<=1+2/z, so nonnegative x can exist only if 1+2/z>=0, yielding z<=-2; checking the second inequality is then compatible. Hence the range is z<=-2 or z>=2/3.
method.CoT_raw:
本题无图像信息需要使用，直接按参数存在法处理。设 z 为参数，由 z=\frac{y+2}{x-1} 得 y=z(x-1)-2，其中 x\ne 1。代入约束 y\ge 0 与 x+2y\le 4，得到 z(x-1)\ge 2，以及 x+2[z(x-1)-2]\le 4，即 (1+2z)x\le 8+2z，同时还要 x\ge 0。又因为 y\ge 0，所以 y+2>0，因此 z=\frac{y+2}{x-1} 的符号由 x-1 决定，z=0 不可能，分 z>0 和 z<0 讨论。

当 z>0 时，由 z(x-1)\ge 2 得 x\ge 1+\frac{2}{z}；又 1+2z>0，由 (1+2z)x\le 8+2z 得 x\le \frac{8+2z}{1+2z}。存在满足条件的 x，需要 1+\frac{2}{z}\le \frac{8+2z}{1+2z}。因 z>0 且 1+2z>0，可交叉相乘： (z+2)(1+2z)\le z(8+2z)。展开得 2z^2+5z+2\le 2z^2+8z，即 2\le 3z，所以 z\ge \frac{2}{3}。

当 z<0 时，由 z(x-1)\ge 2 得 x\le 1+\frac{2}{z}。又 x\ge 0，所以要有 1+\frac{2}{z}\ge 0。由于 z<0，解得 z\le -2。对任意 z\le -2，可取 x=1+\frac{2}{z}, y=0，则 x\ge 0 且 x+2y=x\le 1\le 4，并且 \frac{y+2}{x-1}=\frac{2}{2/z}=z，所以这些 z 都能取到。

综合两种情况，z 的取值范围是 (-\infty,-2]\cup[\frac{2}{3},+\infty)。

Since when x=1 the denominator is 0, z is undefined, so discuss the two parts x<1 and x>1 separately.

When x<1, the denominator x-1<0, while y+2>0, so z<0. Geometrically, it is the slope from point P to feasible points in the left part of the triangle. The maximum value of the negative slope occurs at (0,0), at which time z=\frac{0+2}{0-1}=-2; when the feasible point approaches the line x=1 from the left, the denominator tends to 0^-, and the numerator is still positive, therefore z tends to -∞. So the value range of this part is (-∞,-2].

When x>1, the denominator x-1>0, and y+2>0, so z>0. Geometrically, it is the slope from point P to feasible points in the right part of the triangle. The minimum value of the positive slope occurs at the right-end vertex (4,0), at which time z=\frac{0+2}{4-1}=\frac{2}{3}; when the feasible point approaches the line x=1 from the right, the denominator tends to 0^+, and the numerator is still positive, therefore z tends to +∞. So the value range of this part is [\frac{2}{3},+∞).

Combining the two parts, the value range of z is (-∞,-2]∪[\frac{2}{3},+∞).
